$comment: Implements spec 03 §12 (conformance test vectors: name, programme, input, expect) and C-10 (every pack ships vectors that CI runs). This file is the schema for tests/*.vectors.json.
title: Pack conformance vectors
description: Worked examples that pin the engine's results for this pack (spec 03 §12). A pack cannot be marked verified without them.

name.description: What the vector demonstrates, for example KCSE best-7 with 3 sciences (spec 03 §12).

programme.description: Pack code the vector belongs to, for example ke-844 (spec 03 §12).

input.description: Input by learning-area code, for example a grade string or a raw score. null represents an absent mark (spec 03 §12).

selected.description: Learning areas the aggregation selected, for example the KCSE best-7 set (spec 03 §12).

expectation.description: Expected outcome keyed by aggregation code, plus an optional selected list (spec 03 §12).

total_points.description: Sum of points before the mean (spec 03 §12 example: 69).

value.description: The operator's numeric result before lookup.

grade.description: Resulting grade or band code (spec 03 §12 example: B+).

division.description: Resulting division where the pack uses one, for example II.

aggregateExpectation.description: Expected values for one aggregation. Known fields are typed; additional scalar fields are allowed so a pack can pin engine-specific outputs without a schema change.
